sounds.name: coin_pickup
sounds.prompt: A quick shake of a few coins in a hand, then a single subtle soft bubblegum pop. Short, playful, dry, close, no music, no voice.

sounds.name: weapon_pickup
sounds.prompt: A rifle snatched up off the floor: one firm metallic clack of a gun grabbed into the hands, then a quick crisp bolt pulled back and snapped forward. Short, punchy, satisfying, dry, close, no music, no voice, no gunshot.

sounds.name: footstep_soft
sounds.prompt: Eight quiet footfalls on a padded floor, one every 0.6 seconds, each a short low soft thud with a gentle round body and almost no click, dry and close, with silence between them.

sounds.name: wind_soft
sounds.prompt: Soft steady outdoor wind in an open field, a gentle even airy breeze in the background, constant level, no gusts, no howling, no birds, no voices, no music, seamless loop.
